tierBoards.leadEn: What a group wants from you while learning dungeons. Healers and tanks rank high because groups need them; damage dealers are close to each other.
tierBoards.noteEn: XifanGG flips this for late game, once groups know the fights and bosses die in 30–40 seconds: Assassin and Chanter go to S, Templar and Cleric drop to B. trueeevil puts Chanter low because groups looking for a healer want a Cleric.

tierBoards.titleEn: Mass PvP: Abyss sieges and ZvZ
tierBoards.leadEn: Hundreds of players around an artifact or a boss. Ranged classes and healers do the work; melee gets melted if it walks into the blob.
tierBoards.noteEn: They disagree on the Templar: trueeevil plays it in sieges and rates its pulls into the enemy line; XifanGG thinks a melee can't safely hit a contested boss or artifact.

tierBoards.leadEn: Fights you pick yourself in the Abyss. The classes that are worst in sieges are the best here.
tierBoards.noteEn: The two lists almost match. XifanGG's small-group PvP list is different again: Cleric S, Sorcerer C.

tierBoards.leadEn: Only the damage meter, with equal gear and good play — not what a class brings to the group.
tierBoards.noteEn: Kanon's list is averaged from real parses (top 25% on notmeter.com) across the latest Korean raids, Transcendence and Conquest dungeons — ranged classes lead there because they build Front Attack Damage Boost. KaidWOW ranks the damage ceiling and puts Gladiator first. Balance on global starts from scratch, so take both as a direction.
